name: Biocon Ltd.
about: Biocon Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures biotechnology products and offers research services in India, the United States, Ireland, rest of the European Union, and internationally. It operates through Generics; Biosimilars; and Contract Research, Development and Manufacturing Organization (CRDMO) segments. The company offers generic formulations and API products, including cardiovascular, anti-diabetics, obesity, central nervous system, anti-cancer/oncology, multiple sclerosis, immunosuppressants, and specialty molecules; and biosimilars products for oncology, diabetes, and immunology therapeutic areas. It also provides integrated discovery, development, and manufacturing services to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, animal health, consumer goods, and specialty chemical industries, as well as academic institutions, non-profit organizations, and government agencies. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~43% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~15% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
PE of 131 is near the top of its range over the last 3 years (median 63).
Trades at PE 131 vs sector median 53; peers with similar ROCE and growth trade nearer 69, so the premium is not explained by fundamentals alone.
Profit fell 62% last year, which inflates PE; check whether the drop is cyclical (temporary) or structural.
Since 2023, most of the 12% a year price gain came from re-rating (PE 85 → 131), not earnings growth (-1% a year).
